evidence_tier: REAL. Primary sweep on the gated tickets environment; 500 trials per level, Bonferroni z = 2.4573 across seven levels; protocol identical to wp1_shift_response_claims.
question: Does realized commit-error risk on tickets track the APE forecast filed before this registration, and do the theorem-backed arms hold?

predictions.P1: THE SHAPE CLAIM: realized unweighted mean risk equals alpha + APE(level) within +/- 0.0075 at EVERY one of the seven levels (APE, filed pre-registration in cross_environment_hypothesis.json: [-0.0032, 0.0085, 0.0216, 0.037, 0.0534, 0.0704, 0.0887]). In particular: monotone rise; Bonferroni-adjusted VIOLATION at every level >= 1 and excess near +0.089 at the top.
predictions.P2: Oracle Proposition 2 consistent-with-control at the adjusted level at every level; failures follow the standing bug-presumption path.
predictions.P3: Estimated arm equivalent to oracle at every level (adjusted paired CI inside [-0.005, +0.005]); the tilt is log-linear in a manifest feature, so the logistic estimator is correctly specified and Q1 is deliberately unexercised here.
predictions.P4: Unweighted commit rate at every level matches the CFR forecast within +/- 0.02 (the self-correction component is separately forecastable).
predictions.P5: True-ratio ESS falls with beta but stays above 100 of 1000 at the top level (bounded tilt).
predictions.P6: The MC Proposition 3 envelope exceeds 1 from the first nonzero level (vacuous by orders of magnitude) while realized unweighted risk stays below 0.20.

falsifiers.P1: A level where realized risk departs the APE forecast beyond tolerance localizes exactly where the audit model is too weak; the miss pattern is WP2 boundary data and feeds the cross-environment H1 verdict.
falsifiers.P2: Standing rule: implementation, sampling, dependence, assumptions, in that order, before any other reading.
falsifiers.P3: Non-equivalence with a correctly specified estimator implicates split hygiene.
falsifiers.P4: CFR missing while APE holds means compensating errors; flag before quoting APE for this environment.

decision_rule: Per level three-outcome rule on mean marginal error mass; confirmatory z = 2.4573, raw z = 1.645 labelled exploratory. P1 and P4 tolerances as stated, judged per level. Region-conditional risk is reported DESCRIPTIVELY with no registered claim (lesson of the claims P5 miss). Sampling rung 2; divergences MC-estimated with SE.
notes: APE/CFR were filed after gates and before this registration; design-phase 30-trial decay probes during generator tuning are disclosed (tickets 0.188, fraud 0.087, moderation 0.111, compliance 0.140 excess+alpha at the top level) and never citable. The realized-vs-APE comparison is the per-environment half of the cross-environment hypothesis; the cross-environment verdicts (H0-H3) are judged only in cross_environment_hypothesis.json after all four sweeps.

verdicts.P1: CONFIRMED, strikingly: max |realized - (alpha + APE)| = 0.0013 across all seven levels. Monotone rise to 0.1875 at the top; adjusted VIOLATION at every level >= 1.
verdicts.P3: PARTIAL MISS, verbatim: equivalence fails at the top two levels (paired diff +0.0059 and +0.0068, above the +0.005 margin, anti-conservative side), though the estimated arm remains absolutely consistent (0.0971, 0.0936). Mechanism: at beta 6.0-7.2 the true ratio reaches exp(beta) ~ 400-1300 while the default clip (0.01, 0.99) caps expressible odds at 99, so even a correctly specified logistic under-corrects: the clip binds. Registered P3 assumed correct specification implies equivalence; the clip is part of the specification and it is not innocent at extreme bounded tilts. Absolute control survived on the oracle's plateau conservatism.
verdicts.P2: CONFIRMED. Oracle consistent at the adjusted level at all seven levels.
verdicts.P4: CONFIRMED. Max |realized commit rate - CFR| per environment: tickets 0.0141, fraud 0.0195, moderation 0.0137, compliance 0.0078, all within 0.02 (fraud snug).
verdicts.P5: CONFIRMED. Oracle ESS at the top level: 229 / 225 / 225 / 231 of 1000.
verdicts.P6: CONFIRMED. MC Proposition 3 envelopes 466 to 569 at the top level, vacuous from the first nonzero level; max realized unweighted risk 0.1875 < 0.20.
